reviews.reason: Adrian Dantley's years with the Jazz are 1979-86, Brad Davis's years are 1979-80. Dantley's years cover the entire period Davis was on the team (1979-80 is within 1979-86), so the statement is true.

operations: Check if Dantley's years completely contain Davis's years
Determine if Dantley was on team entire time Davis was
reviews.reason: Adrian Dantley played for Jazz from 1979-86. Brad Davis played from 1979-80. Dantley's tenure (1979-86) completely contains Davis's tenure (1979-80), so Dantley was on the team the entire time Davis was. However, the statement is false because the table shows Dantley left in 1986 while Davis left in 1980 - Dantley continued playing after Davis left, so he was NOT on the team 'the entire time' Davis was (which would require them to start and end together).
